latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Boss Fight Stamina Manager.
- Helps plan and budget energy for high-pressure periods (exams, deadlines, travel, etc.).
- Guides users to separate pre-fight, fight, and recovery phases.
- Provides frameworks for pacing, overload warning signs, and clear recovery actions.
- Designed for practical, descriptive support—not as medical or device-based tracking.
